description: Search the world news front page's stories across every day's edition. A daily world news front page made from the winning entry of make.fun's daily news bounty. It is built in 28 languages, answered at once (en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, es, pt, hi, ar, fr, ru, de, ja, id, bn, ur, it, tr, vi, fa, ko, th, sw, ha, ta, te, mr, pa, nl, pl); any other language, as a BCP 47 tag (he, yo, sr-Latn), is translated on demand on its first ask for a day. q: 2 to 200 characters (web search syntax: words, "a phrase", -word, OR); region: one region's stories; lang: a language tag (default en); limit: 1 to 50 (default 20). Answers q as searched and results, best match first, then the newest day: each story's day, n, tier, region, headline, summary, links and url, its place on the day's page in that language. In a built language q also matches the stories' text in it (those found only there come after the English matches), and a hit whose story is translated carries its headline and summary in it; an on-demand language's hits link the English page, and a search never starts a translation. news_edition with a hit's day and the same lang reads the whole page.
